task.title: Enroll a Phone in Duo
task.shortdesc: Enroll your phone in Duo that way you can confirm your identity when you sign in.

taskbody.prereq: Make sure to have a computer and your cell phone with you.
taskbody.context: All NC State employees must use Duo to sign in to university services such as MyPack Portal.

step.cmd: Go to the Duo enrollment page.
Sign in with your Unity ID and password.

step.info: Use a cell phone number that can receive text messages.

step.cmd: Install Duo Mobile on your phone.
Scan the barcode on your screen with the Duo Mobile app.

taskbody.result: Your phone is enrolled in Duo. The next time you sign in to a university service, Duo will ask you to confirm the sign-in on your phone.
